title: Kashi, Prayagraj & Ayodhya: 6 Days on the Sacred Ganga Trail
card_points: Triveni Sangam and Ayodhya’s Ram Mandir
overview: Three of India’s holiest cities in one unhurried journey: Varanasi on the Ganga, Prayagraj where three rivers meet, and Ayodhya, birthplace of Lord Rama.

Watch the evening Ganga Aarti, take a sunrise boat past the ghats, bathe at the Triveni Sangam and offer prayers at the Ram Mandir. A private vehicle, a tour manager, comfortable stays and all meals are included.

highlights.title: Kashi Vishwanath
highlights.text: The Jyotirlinga temple and its riverfront corridor in Varanasi

highlights.title: Triveni Sangam
highlights.text: Confluence of the Ganga, Yamuna and the mythical Saraswati

highlights.title: Ayodhya
highlights.text: Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir and Hanuman Garhi

itinerary.title: Arrival in Varanasi
itinerary.subtitle: Ganga Aarti · Overnight: Varanasi
itinerary.intro: Arrive in Varanasi and check in.

activities.title: Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat
activities.text: Watch from the ghats or from a boat on the river.

activities.title: Boat ride along the ghats
activities.text: From Assi to Manikarnika as the city wakes.

activities.title: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
activities.text: Darshan at the Jyotirlinga, then Annapurna Devi and Kaal Bhairav.

activities.title: Sarnath
activities.text: Where the Buddha gave his first sermon — Dhamek Stupa and the museum.

activities.title: Boat to the Triveni Sangam
activities.text: A holy dip at the meeting point of three rivers.

activities.title: Drive to Ayodhya
activities.text: About four hours, with a lunch stop.

activities.title: Saryu Aarti at Ram ki Paidi
Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir
activities.text: Phones and bags are deposited at the lockers before entry.

activities.title: Hanuman Garhi
activities.text: Hilltop Hanuman temple reached by steps.

activities.title: Drop-off
activities.text: At Ayodhya airport or Lucknow for your onward journey.

inclusions: Boat rides in Varanasi and Prayagraj

good_to_know.title: Dress code
good_to_know.text: Traditional or modest clothing is recommended at all temples. Footwear is removed before entering.

good_to_know.title: What to carry
good_to_know.text: A valid photo ID, comfortable walking shoes, a water bottle and any regular medication.

good_to_know.title: Physical activity
good_to_know.text: Some shrines involve steps or hill climbs. Tell us about mobility needs and we’ll plan accordingly.

good_to_know.title: Best time to visit
good_to_know.text: October to March is the most comfortable time. Summers are very hot, and the Magh Mela (January–February) brings large crowds to Prayagraj.

faqs.question: Where does the tour start and end?
faqs.answer: The tour starts in Varanasi and ends with a drop-off at Ayodhya airport or Lucknow.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customised?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can add or skip temples, change hotel categories, or extend your stay. Share your preferences when you enquire.

faqs.question: Is this tour suitable for senior citizens?
faqs.answer: Yes. Travel is by private vehicle and the pace is comfortable. Tell us about any mobility needs in advance.

faqs.question: Are special darshan tickets included?
faqs.answer: No, special darshan tickets are not included, but our team can help you book them where available.
